answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose a novel approach to tackle the extended summary generation for scientific documents.
answer_1.outputs: Extended summaries (roughly 600 terms) of scientific papers

answer_2.quote: Overall, our model achieves about 1.4%, 2.4%, 3.5% (arXiv-Long), and 1.0%, 2.5%, 1.3% (PubMed-Long) improvements across ROUGE score variants; and 2.2% (arXiv-Long), 1.4% (PubMed-Long) improvements over F1, compared to the neural baselines.

answer_4.quote: For the sake of evaluation, two annotators were asked to manually evaluate two sets of 40 papers' groundtruth abstracts (40 for arXiv-Long, and 40 for PubMed-Long) with their generated extended summaries (baselines' and ours) to gain insights into qualities of each model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to specify if the first system-generated summary wins/loses or ties with the second system-generated summary in terms of qualitative metrics.
